item.title: Tamaqua Tops Pine Grove in Overtime, Strengthens Hold on Final League Playoff Spot
item.description: In a crucial Schuylkill League Division 1 matchup with major playoff implications, the Tamaqua Lady Raiders outlasted the Pine Grove Lady Cardinals, 36-29, in overtime Thursday night at Tamaqua Area High School. item.title: Vehicle Restrictions to Take Effect on Interstates, Turnpike During Winter Storm
item.description: PennDOT has announced that Tier 4 vehicle restrictions will go into effect beginning 12:01 a.m. Sunday, January 25, as a major winter storm is expected to impact central Pennsylvania. The restrictions will apply to all Pennsylvania interstates, the Pennsylvania Turnpike and its extensions, along with several other major roadways across the state.
